title: Ossoff Criticizes Trump as Spiritually Broken | Politics News - World Today News
text:
U.S. Senator Jon Ossoff has publicly characterized former President Donald Trump as a “spiritually broken president,” accusing him of prioritizing personal retribution and financial gain during his time in office. The remarks, delivered in recent days, represent a sharp escalation of Ossoff’s criticism of the former president.
Ossoff’s assessment, reported by The Hill on February 17, 2026, centers on accusations that Trump leveraged the power of the presidency for self-serving purposes. The senator did not detail specific instances in his initial statement, but subsequent appearances have focused on what he describes as a pattern of abuse of power.
Speaking at a campaign rally in Atlanta on February 7, 2026, Ossoff told supporters, “the first light of dawn is on the horizon,” a statement interpreted by some observers as a reference to the conclusion of Trump’s political influence. He has also directly challenged Trump’s continued claims regarding the 2020 presidential election, according to a YouTube video released February 16, 2026.
On February 18, 2026, Ossoff elaborated on his concerns in a post shared on the Colbert Late Show ’s Facebook page, stating that his work exposing corruption and abuses of power on a global scale increasingly mirrored the political climate in the United States under Trump’s leadership. This comparison suggests a concern that the principles Ossoff has championed internationally are now under threat domestically.
The senator’s criticisms come as Trump continues to actively campaign for a return to the presidency. Trump has not directly responded to Ossoff’s “spiritually broken” characterization, but has consistently dismissed accusations of wrongdoing as politically motivated attacks.
As of February 19, 2026, the White House has not issued a statement regarding Ossoff’s remarks. Trump is scheduled to hold a rally in South Carolina on February 22, 2026, where he is expected to address recent criticisms and outline his policy agenda.
